enquiries.subject: Institutional MoU for 2026-27 Final Year Student Training
enquiries.message: We would like to explore partnering with Haridra to deliver an on-campus HACCP and Food Safety Practitioner certificate course for our graduating cohort of 60 students.
enquiries.internal_notes: Follow up with academic liaison team to schedule introductory video conference.

enquiries.subject: Pre-Inspection Diagnostic Food Safety Audit
enquiries.message: We operate two central commissaries supplying 45 outlets. We require a comprehensive hygiene and HACCP compliance audit across both facilities next month.
enquiries.internal_notes: Diagnostic audit scope document sent via email. Awaiting facility floor plans.

enquiries.subject: Corporate Cohort Enrollment for 8 QA Executives
enquiries.message: We want to enroll our internal QA and line supervisors in the upcoming batch of the Food Safety Internal Auditor course. Please share group pricing and scheduling details.
enquiries.internal_notes: Spoke on phone on Nov 20. Sent corporate proposal with 15% group concession.
